title: Northbeam TechWorks Liaison Note: Plan Cover and Circle Membership
content:
Holding a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan or a Northbeam Circle Membership changes what work under Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair costs.

## Where a plan covers the work

Where a protection plan standing active, or standing in review while an earlier claim is looked at, authorises the work and the service covers plan labour, the labour and the crew attendance charge are written off against the plan and only parts outside the plan are billed.

## Where no plan covers the work

Where no plan covers the work and the service applies the membership discount, two clauses that formerly governed the order and the spending of a member's benefit are **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for a membership relief: the clause that the membership tier's repair labour discount is taken off the chargeable labour before any surcharge is added, and the clause that the membership's service benefit credit may then be spent against what is left.

## Plan cover and the membership discount are never applied to the same labour line

Covered labour is already free, so a discount on it is meaningless.

## A membership that is not in good standing

The clause that a membership standing in grace on a tier that suspends benefits gives neither the discount nor the credit, and the charge stands in full, is likewise **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for when a Circle membership gives neither.

## The day the standings are read

The membership tier and the plan status are both read as they stand on the day the work is carried out, not the day the job was booked.

## Points of judgement

**A plan standing in review while an earlier claim is looked at.** That standing is named in the opening clause alongside an active plan, so a plan in review may authorise the work for the purposes of this note.

**A job the plan covers, carried out for a member.** Plan cover and the membership discount never reach the same labour line, so the covered labour is written off to the plan and no discount is taken on it.

**A job booked under one tier and carried out under another.** The tier read is the tier standing on the day the work is carried out.

The per-service flags this note reads — whether labour is covered where a protection plan authorises the work, whether the Circle tier's repair labour discount is applied to chargeable labour, and the service's own hourly rate — are carried in the cover applicability and labour tariff schedules for the six TechWorks services.
